policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Reports $11B raised at $1.25T valuation
items.summary: TechCrunch reports O is raising an additional $11B in a private round, valuing the company at about $1.25T. The same reporting frames it as an effort to stay ahead of a near-term peer listing.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 Cyber for verified users
items.summary: Axios reports O released a GPT-6 “Cyber” model to a subset of verified users, citing its top cybersecurity capability rating (“critical”). Product capability signals incremental competitive strength in security workloads.

items.headline: O: Data center power commitments via framework
items.summary: AP reports O published a framework describing new commitments for communities near its data centers, and ties this to expectations of a tougher AI/data-center regulatory environment after the midterms.

items.headline: V: W-6 reentry validates AutoNav
items.summary: V’s mission page describes W-6 carrying payloads to advance autonomous navigation and thermal protection, including validation of its AutoNav system during hypersonic reentry conditions.

items.headline: V: $251M Series D for in-space pharma processing
items.summary: PRNewswire reports V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, citing total capital raised of $598M and referencing increased mission cadence through 2028.
